Subject: KEK rotation artifacts + HSM attestation request

Marcus —

Thanks again for taking this on. Our SIG/CAIQ review flagged a few items where we need documented evidence for the tenant key encryption key (KEK) lifecycle across Redwood’s Hosted offering. Specifically Can you provide the following artifacts (redacted is fine where appropriate):

- Rotation index for KEK (last 24 months) with timestamps and actor IDs
- Representative rotation log samples (cryptographic events only) for 3 rotations across 2028–2029
- A manifest showing how the rotation artifacts were transferred (S3 path / sftp manifest)
- HSM attestation from your vendor for the BYOK path (or vendor contact if we need vendor-signed PDFs)
- A simple mapping that shows which KMS roles/users can wrap/unwrap KEKs (access matrix)

We’re trying to close this by EOD 2029-04-02. If you can share an initial bundle (sanitized) and a plan for full deliverables, that would be perfect.

If a short call helps, I can make time Monday.

Thanks,
Michael

On Fri, Mar 29, 2029 at 09:01, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com> wrote:
> Irene / Naomi — forwarding a Clearwave security request (below).

Thanks — I’ll assemble the sanitized bundle. Plan below:

1) Rotation index: export of rotation metadata (no key material) for last 24 months -> CSV that lists rotation_id, timestamp, actor, rotation_type (scheduled/emergency), model_binding, notes. (owner: me)
2) Rotation log samples: pick three event windows (one scheduled, one emergency, one rollback) and export the cryptographic event lines only; redact principal session ids; attach as separate CSVs. (owner: naomi_feldman)
3) Transfer manifest: gather S3 put/get logs showing the object paths and provide an s3-manifest JSON with checksums and transfer timestamps; include an sftp receipts.txt if we used SFTP. (owner: marissa_cole)
4) HSM attestation: I contacted vendor (nds-hsm@vendor.example.com) and requested the signed attestation PDF and firmware inventory; vendor indicated they can provide a signed attestation for the November 2028 ceremony. If vendor signs, we’ll include the PDF; otherwise, we’ll include our vendor correspondence and the HSM serial + firmware hash. (owner: irene_choi)
5) Access matrix: a table mapping internal roles (kms.admin, kms.rotation-service, support-readonly) to actions (wrap/unwrap/list/rotate). Export as XLSX and a redacted text table. (owner: naomi_feldman)

ETA: initial sanitized bundle delivered Monday 2029-04-01 by 16:00 PT. Full artifact set (including vendor-signed attestation if available) targeted 2029-04-03.

Attachments I will stage for the initial bundle:
- kms-rotation-index-2027-2029.csv (metadata only)
- rotation-sample-scheduled-2028-07.csv
- rotation-sample-emergency-2028-11.csv
- s3-manifest-clearwave-20290329.json (paths + checksums)
- vendor-correspondence-nds-20290329.eml

I’ll upload to the folder and post the link when ready.

—Irene
